action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.81) with moderate seasonality and non-stationarity. Model ranking is unstable across the 3 validation windows (Kendall tau 0.119) and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.86, only 1 independent group), so no subset or fitted weighting can reliably exploit differences. DBA (DTW barycenter) is a robust, non-parametric combination that avoids overfitting to the few windows, and its margin over the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable. All baselines cluster tightly (0.66–0.71), confirming the pool is homogeneous and no single model or weighting scheme offers a clear edge.
